entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of David. Save me, O God! for the waters have come in on [my] soul.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: I sink in deep mire, where [there is] no standing; I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am weary from my crying; my throat is dried; my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: They who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they who would destroy me are mighty, my lying enemies. Then I restored [what] I did not take away.

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: O God, You know my foolishness, and my guiltiness [is] not hidden from You.

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Do not let those who wait on You, O LORD God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake; let not the ones who seek You be ashamed for my sake, O God of Israel,

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: because I have borne reproach for Your sake, shame has covered my face.

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I have become a stranger to My brothers, and a foreigner to My mother's children.

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: For the zeal of Your house has eaten Me up; and the reproaches of those who reproached You have fallen on Me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: When I humbled my soul with fasting, it turned to my reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: I also made sackcloth my clothing, and I became a proverb to them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: They who sit in the gate speak against me; and I [was] the song of the drunkards.

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: But [as for] me, my prayer [is] to You, O LORD, [in] a pleasing time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy hear me, in the truth of Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Do not let the flood of waters overflow me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut its mouth on me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Hear me, O LORD, for Your loving-kindness [is] good; turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: And hide not Your face from Your servant; for I am in trouble; hear me quickly.

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Draw near my soul, and redeem it; deliver me because of my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor; my enemies [are] all before You.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness; and I looked [for some] to mourn with me, but [there was] none; and for comforters, but I found none.

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: They also gave Me gall for my food; and in My thirst they gave Me vinegar to drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: Let their table become a snare before them; and to those at ease a trap.

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; and make their loins shake without ceasing.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Pour out Your wrath on them, and let the glow of Your anger take hold of them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Let their dwelling be wasted; let none dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: For they persecute [him] whom You have stricken, and they talk to the grief of those You pierced.

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not come into Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let them be blotted out of the Book of Life, and not be written with the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I [am] poor and sorrowful; let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify Him with thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox, [or] a bull that has horns and hoofs.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The humble shall see [and] be glad; and your heart shall live, you who seek God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For the LORD hears the needy, and does not despise His prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let the heavens and earth praise Him, the seas, and everything that moves in them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; so that they may dwell there, and possess it.

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: And the seed of His servants shall inherit it, and they who love His name shall dwell in it.
